examples.en: That [David Ben-Gurion] believed that there would be no peace between Israel and the Arab masses only happened later, after the war in 1948. Prior to that, from 1936 to 1939, he – as the Zionist leader – had ordered restraint from retaliation against Arab attacks on Jewish civilians.
